title: Circles per Space follow the value ladder: a free Space runs its Space Circle only, Business 5, Collective 10, Network unlimited

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: "For value ladder. Let's do this for Circles. Free: Primary Circle included. Business: 5 Circles. Collective: 10 Circles. Network: Unlimited Circles. Crew and up can have 5 non busines circles each."

detail: space_circles was free 3, Business 10, Collective unlimited (Network read Collective). It is now free 1 (the Space Circle counts toward it), Business 5, Collective 10, and Network names its own unlimited. The personal circle_host row already gives Crew 5 Circles and a free Member 1, so it is unchanged. The add-Circle check (checkSpaceCircleMeter) and the pricing comparison table both read the row, so no other number moves. No Circle is ever removed: the cap only refuses a new one, and it bites when beta_grace ends.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!/space_circles: \{ free: 1, business: 5, collective: 10, network: null \}/.test(m))bad.push('Circles per Space are not 1, 5, 10, unlimited');if(!/circle_host: \{ free: 1, crew: 5 \}/.test(m))bad.push('Crew does not host 5 Circles');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-981: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
